    Basic facts about module endomorphisms #

    A nontrivial endomorphism semiring forces the underlying module to be nontrivial. Together with Mathlib's converse instance, this identifies nontriviality on the two sides without assumptions on the endomorphism semiring beyond nontriviality itself.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.nontrivial_of_nontrivial_end {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Nontrivial (Module.End R M)] :
    Nontrivial M

    A module with nontrivial endomorphism semiring is nontrivial.
